enemies.grid_notes: THE EINHERJAR DEBUT (C-DEATH-02) — a unit from the player's own fallen roster, returned rune-lit at its final job (Wyrmslayer here), final abilities, gear tier +1; if the roster has no fallen unit a scripted stand-in fills the slot. Striking it down UNHOOKS it from the harvest: +1 Wyrd Point, a unique saga line, einherjar_unhooked++. CONSUME is unavailable here (consume_rite_known not yet set) — the design guard. It is rune-lit, so it is one of the few things that sees in the dark.
Barrow-dead skirmisher moving unlit through the fog; hunts the player's torch-bearers to blind the light-radius LoS.
Dead archer holding the E crowned barrow ([11,5] grave_goods) — dangerous only while a fire lights its crown; unlit it is nearly blind too.
Grave-cold berserker rising from the road-cut at [9,10]; drives the player off the corpse_road lane.

neutrals.grid_notes: SALGERD 'the Grey-Guest' (C-EMISSARY-01) — a DEAD witness who walks the corpse_road north and cannot be targeted or removed; her presence forces the True ledger (C-ALIGN-02). Following her lane (unit_off_zone:n1:corpse_road) advances hel_arc_stage toward corpse_road_walked, marking the overlays that lead to the concealed door.

secondary: Unhook the returned einherji (e1) rather than fleeing it (einherjar_unhooked +1).
Walk the full corpse_road lane Salgerd marks (advances hel_arc_stage toward corpse_road_walked).

triggers.note: The dead stand up rune-lit; the valkyrie VFX that played straight in Ch1 is now visibly the DESCENT it always was. Advances harvest_lie_stage -> undeniable (resolution script owns the monotonic write).
The returned face is unhooked from the harvest: +1 Wyrd, a unique saga line, einherjar_unhooked += 1 (C-DEATH-02).
Walking Salgerd's corpse_road lane advances hel_arc_stage toward corpse_road_walked — the prerequisite for finding ch3-07 (resolution script owns the monotonic write).

designer_notes.height_gimmick: Sight is LIGHT-RADIUS, not elevation, and the fog eats the rest: standing on a 3h barrow crown buys zero vision while it is unlit, so torch-bearers become the map's true 'towers' and a crown matters only while a fire burns on it. The whole vertical logic of every prior map is switched off and replaced by a darkness-LoS economy where illumination — not height — is the terrain advantage, wholly distinct from ch1-05's sightline-as-testimony and every other map's climb math.
designer_notes.witness_setup: Salgerd 'the Grey-Guest' walks the corpse-road: a DEAD witness no blade can remove, so whatever happens here is written True, in full, forever (C-ALIGN-02, always_sung). There are no living neutrals to silence; the account cannot be edited by killing, only by what Grím actually does in the dark.
designer_notes.intent: SHOWCASE and the einherjar debut (C-DEATH-02): the first returned face from the player's own roster; teaches unhook (default, +Wyrd + saga line) and PLANTS the corpse_road overlays that lead to the concealed door — walking them advances hel_arc_stage toward corpse_road_walked. The chapter's 'the blood wakes' made playable.
